SELECT t.user_id AS userId, t.username AS username, COALESCE(MAX(su.real_name), MAX(t.real_name)) AS realName, COUNT(*) AS totalDays, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absentCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END AS complianceRate FROM oa_attendance t LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = t.user_id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL AND t.attendance_date >= #{start} AND t.attendance_date <= #{end}
GROUP BY t.user_id, t.username HAVING totalDays >= 5 ORDER BY complianceRate ASC, lateCount DESC LIMIT 20
